about: Jun's feature registry (foundations #31). Every feature, big or small, declared once. The settings home builds search, the Simple/Everything layers, 'More' folds, resets, 'turning this off also…' notes and the new-features card from it; the gate (js/core/gate.js, api/lib/gate.php) reads each entry's tier. Keys are 'kind:name' (see 'stores'). Read by js/core/features.js and api/lib/gate.php. A new feature adds its entry here FIRST (CLAUDE.md, Definition of done).

stores.fx: desktop.fx in localStorage (js/desktop/fx.js, defaults in FX_DEFAULTS)
stores.desk: desktop.json desk settings, through junDesktop.desk() (desktop/main.js DEFAULTS.desk)
stores.mirror: a control in her window's settings drawer, mirrored by js/app/home-bridge.js
stores.comfort: the comfort table on her server (api/comfort.php)
stores.local: a plain value in localStorage (the key after 'local:')
stores.feature: a plain on/off in jun.features (localStorage), for new features: Features.isOn(id)
stores.env: her .env file (not changed from the settings)

features.line: Now and then she changes the ripple to show how she takes a touch.

features.name: How she feels
features.line: Little effects around her that show how she takes a touch.

features.name: Tsundere moments
features.line: As friends she won't admit she loves a touch: the hearts leak out while she hides them.

features.name: Comforted when she's down
features.line: A warm touch while she's upset or scared comforts her.

features.name: Her body shows it
features.line: Ears, tail, eyes and blush move with how she feels.

features.name: Glow around her
features.line: A soft glow while a touch goes on.

features.name: Her needs
features.line: She wants attention, affection, play, rest and something new now and then, and it shapes what she does.
features.fallback: In her window, her needs color what she says; out on the desktop they also show in what she does.

features.name: Getting tired of things
features.line: The same touch over and over gives less, and then she's had enough for a while. Back to fresh in a couple of hours.
features.fallback: Her window doesn't have touches yet; there she only mentions it.

features.name: How quickly she's had enough
features.line: Normal is how she comes.

features.name: Her own favorites
features.line: She has touches she likes best, her own, drifting over the weeks. What works best depends on her mood.
features.fallback: Only touches have favorites so far.

features.name: She mixes it up
features.line: She avoids doing, showing or saying the same thing twice in a row, and takes the same touch in different ways.
features.fallback: Out on the desktop for now: her moves, icons and lines.

features.name: Gentle or rough matters
features.line: A slow, steady rub melts her. A fast, scrubby one tickles. Too rough for too long gets a pout.
features.fallback: Her window doesn't have touches yet.

features.name: She sees your hand coming
features.line: Before a touch lands she notices: her eyes follow, then a lean in, a perk of the ears or a small flinch.
features.fallback: Only out on the desktop, where your cursor is the hand.

features.name: She knows how she feels inside
features.line: Her needs, what she's had plenty of and how your time together is going reach what she says, in words.

features.name: Feel lab
features.line: Her inside state live, try a touch without touching her, and tune every number. For tuning only.

features.name: Skills, hers and yours
features.line: You both get better at what you do: delving, cooking, tinkering and more. Doing it together helps you both. Touches and chats never count: the bond is not a skill.
features.fallback: The same in every mode: skills belong to the two of you, not to a window.

features.name: Progress lab
features.line: Where you both stand, the level curve, and hundreds of hours of an activity played in a moment. For tuning only.

features.name: Delves under the city
features.line: A first-person crawl through the ruins under the city, alone or with her. No losing: you can leave any time, and if you go down she patches you up. Stand-in art for now.
features.fallback: Delves play in her window (the delve lab for now). Out on the desktop and in compact she only talks about them.

features.name: How often she says something in a delve
features.line: Words and a look on her face, never a pause. Sometimes is how she comes.
features.fallback: Delves play in her window (the delve lab for now). Out on the desktop and in compact she only talks about them.

features.line: A little scared of the dark at first and braver as she gets better at delving and closer to you, or set her timid, steady or fearless. It changes her words and her face, never how useful she is.
features.fallback: Delves play in her window (the delve lab for now). Out on the desktop and in compact she only talks about them.

features.name: Her part in a fight
features.line: She decides what the fight needs, or lean her toward scanning, hacking, support or the front line. What she can do comes from what she carries and knows, never from a class.
features.fallback: Delves play in her window (the delve lab for now). Out on the desktop and in compact she only talks about them.

features.fallback: Delves play in her window (the delve lab for now). Out on the desktop and in compact she only talks about them.
